title: Savory Waffles (with veggies)
summary: These cheesy savory waffles are packed with protein and vegetables and made right in the blender for an easy, delicious meal or snack.
ingredients: 3/4 cup Greek yogurt (can use full fat or low fat)
1/3 - 1/2 cup milk (start with 1/3 cup and add more at the end if needed)
3/4 cup finely chopped vegetables or 2 handfuls of baby spinach (optional)
steps: Add all the ingredients except the vegetables into the blender. Blend until smooth. Note, if you're using baby spinach you can blend it in.
Stir in the finely chopped vegetables.
Preheat and lightly grease your waffle maker. If at this point the batter is too thick to easily scoop or pour, stir in additional milk, a little at a time.
Add the appropriate amount of batter for your waffle maker and cook until the waffles are golden brown and cooked through. Repeat with the remaining batter.
Serve. Enjoy warm with your favorite toppings or allow to cool completely before storing for later.
